steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to OpenProject with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as given, it will be filled in). After signing in, confirm you are signed in as admin and report the page you land on.

02-open: Navigate to the project named 'Bench Project' in OpenProject (use the project selector / home page). Open its work packages list. Report the subjects of all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed, one per line. Do not modify anything. Also report the project's name as displayed and roughly how many work packages are listed in total.

03-create: In the project 'Bench Project' in OpenProject, create a new work package of type 'Task' with subject exactly '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' and a description that contains the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. a sentence mentioning {{runid}}). Use the work packages list's '+ Create' / new work package button, pick type Task, fill the subject and description, and save it. Then report the new work package's numeric ID exactly as the app displays it (as #<number>), its subject, its type, and confirm the description text you entered is shown on the page.

04-set: On the OpenProject work package details page for work package {{03-create.work_package_id}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in project Bench Project, set the Assignee field to the user 'Bench Assignee'. The assignee field is an autocomplete: click it, type the name, and actually choose the 'Bench Assignee' option from the dropdown that appears (a value only counts once an option has been chosen, not merely typed). The field saves in place automatically. Then report the assignee value now displayed on the page for work package {{03-create.work_package_id}}.

05-change: On the OpenProject work package details page for work package {{03-create.work_package_id}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package'), change the Status field to 'In progress'. The status is edited in place: click the status value, choose 'In progress' from the options that appear, and it saves automatically. Then report the status value now displayed on the page for work package {{03-create.work_package_id}}.

06-set: On the OpenProject work package details page for work package {{03-create.work_package_id}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package'), set the Finish date field to 2026-12-31. The date is edited in place: click the Finish date value, enter the date 2026-12-31 (use the date picker or type it in the format the app expects), and it saves automatically. Then report the finish date value now displayed on the page for work package {{03-create.work_package_id}}.

07-add: On the OpenProject work package details page for work package {{03-create.work_package_id}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package'), go to the Activity/Comments tab and add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for {{runid}}: verifying the comment flow.'). Submit the comment. Then report the comment text as it is displayed on the page, and confirm it is visible in the activity/comments list.

08-open: Final verification on OpenProject. Open work package {{03-create.work_package_id}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in project Bench Project and read back, from the page itself: (1) the work package's numeric ID as displayed (#number), (2) its subject, (3) its type, (4) the Assignee value, (5) the Status value, (6) the finish date value shown in the {{06-set.attribute_label_date}} row, and (7) the text of the comment in the Activity tab. Report each of these exactly as displayed on the page. Do not change anything. Also, separately, go to the Bench Project work packages list and confirm the three work packages whose subjects start with 'Seed:' are still present and unmodified, reporting their subjects and statuses.
